about: What `node tools/polestar.js i18n leaks` (tools/lib/i18n/leaks.js) lets show in English, per locale: "kind:id" of a game name the names addon cannot give in that language, and "text:<the text>" of a text whose English a translation keeps (a name the translation writes as in English, such as a Forever-only place), each with its reason and the scenes it shows in.

A new English text fails; so does an entry whose scenes all ran in its locale, with the Codex and quest database built, without it showing (fixed: remove it). `i18n leaks --update-baseline` adds what the run found and drops the stale entries; it never takes English from the code or an untranslated string or guide text.

reasons.no-source: no source of `i18n names` (the client tables, the Wowhead cache, DingDB, pfQuest) names it in this language: mostly Forever's own NPCs, objects and items; the client shows its own name once the player has seen it (Names.Learn)
reasons.same-as-english: every source names it in this language as in English (a Latin-script client keeps the name): the English is the client's name, and the names addon does not store it
reasons.kept-english: a translation writes these words as the English does: mostly the names of Forever-only places and items no client names otherwise; a translator can still translate them
